states.notes: The Niedersachsen lane now fully bridges the archived lower-secondary pilot subset on its arithmetic base, first functions surface, the fully imported algebra strip on elementare Termumformungen including einfache Verhaeltnisgleichungen, and the fully imported measurement strip on Laengen, Flaechen- und Rauminhalte including plane-figure area formulas, prism measures, and representation work with Schraegbildern and Netzen. It also fully bridges the archived upper-secondary pilot subset across its orientation layer, elementare Funktionenlehre entry strip, derivative entry strip, retained AB3 usage split on tangents, monotonicity/extrema, inflection points, and optimization, plus the fully imported gA learning areas `Von der Aenderung zum Bestand - Integralrechnung`, `Die e-Funktion`, `Raumanschauung und Koordinatisierung`, and `Daten und Zufall` on reconstructed stocks, product sums, geometric intuition for the Hauptsatz, antiderivatives, areas between graphs, proportional growth speed, characterising the base e, derivative use for e^x and a^x, linked functions, product and chain rule with linear inner function, tuples for points and vectors, coordinate-based spatial descriptions, vector operations, collinearity, parametric line and plane forms, scalar product, point distances, line angles, and line relations/intersections, as well as conditional probabilities, stochastic independence, discrete random variables, expectation / variance / standard deviation, fair games, binomial modelling, prediction intervals, first sample-compatibility checks, and simulations. The lane now also fully bridges the first five imported eA follow-ons: `Von der Aenderung zum Bestand - Integralrechnung` on integral functions, the distinction between integral and antiderivative functions, extended antiderivative work including ln as an antiderivative, and advanced deepenings on solids of revolution and improper integrals; `Wachstumsmodelle - Exponentialfunktion` on bounded and logistic growth, model comparison, asymptotic behaviour in context, first-order differential equations as growth models, characterising the base e, derivative use for e^x and a^x, linked e/polynomial functions, product and chain rule, parameter fitting, and solution checks by substitution; `Raumanschauung und Koordinatisierung` (eA) on projections with matrices, expanded plane representations, distances between points/lines/planes, angles between lines and planes, combined line-plane-plane position work, spatial intersection problems, and Gauss elimination in geometric contexts; `Kurvenanpassung und Funktionenscharen` (eA) on global graph properties, fitting function terms to data, translating local graph properties into term conditions, piecewise continuity / differentiability constraints, and parameter-dependent comparison and variation of function families; and `Daten und Zufall` (eA) on conditional probabilities, stochastic independence, critical reading of causal vs. stochastic claims, discrete random variables, expectation / variance / standard deviation, fair games, binomial modelling, prediction intervals, normal distributions, normal approximation, sigma-neighbourhoods, confidence intervals, confidence-level interpretation, and simulations.
states.nextStep: Move the Niedersachsen widening to the next Sek-I geometry / algebra corridor unless a separate Berufliches-Gymnasium lane is opened intentionally, because the first shared general-Gymnasium upper-secondary pilot surface is now exhausted.

states.notes: The BW lane now reaches the full reviewed Klassen-5/6 foundation strip across Zahl-Variable-Operation, Messen, Raum und Form, Funktionaler Zusammenhang, and Daten und Zufall, keeps the reviewed lower-secondary J7/J8 functions and representation strip active, and now also carries the first broad Klassen-7/8 widening across Algebra, Geometrie, and Daten und Zufall with percent and interest work, formula rearrangement, roots, quadratic equations, angle reasoning, congruence, similarity, quartiles, boxplots, and Laplace-style probability. It also still carries the first explicit lower-secondary J9/J10 follow-on around variable terms, power rules, power/root functions, symmetry, and exponential growth with logarithms, now additionally the first broad late-Sek-I geometry / measurement widening in Klassen 9/10 on trigonometry, circle figures, oblique body drawings, nets, cone surfaces, solid volumes, and sphere formulas, the clean late-Sek-I coordinate/vector follow-on on vector basics, spatial coordinate drawings, distances and midpoints, parametric lines, line relations, and rectilinear motion models, the broadened late-Sek-I function / differential widening on trigonometrische Funktionen, periodische Modellierung, derivative entry, basic derivative rules, monotonicity / extrema, tangent / normal / inflection interpretation, and simple sinus/cosinus derivatives, and the first broad late-Sek-I stochastics widening on conditional probabilities, four-field tables, random variables, Bernoulli chains, binomial histograms, and binomial key measures. On the upper-secondary side it carries the first Kursstufe exponential/logarithm/integral corridor from the archived source snapshots, has fully atomically bridged the adjacent upper-secondary calculation-rules follow-on from Zahl-Variable-Operation, has opened the first upper-secondary stochastics follow-on from Daten und Zufall, has opened the first upper-secondary geometry follow-on from Raum und Form plus the linked Leistungsfach and Basisfach Messen strips, has opened the first upper-secondary Gauß / linear-system follow-on, has opened the remaining upper-secondary Messen integral-application strip on limiting processes, means, areas between graphs, and rotation bodies, has now also retain-split the remaining broad upper-secondary Raum-und-Form application atoms on reflections, motions, and area/volume work, and surfaces the reviewed BW Basisfach/Leistungsfach substructure in the learner-facing Kursstufe views.
states.nextStep: Close the remaining BW lower-secondary fine-grained residue outside the now active power, geometry, vector, differential-technique, and stochastics strips, especially the still-open algebra/equation rows in 3.2.1 / 3.3.1, then disposition the still-open non-core source sections while the Kursstufe pilot snapshot remains fully reviewed.

states.notes: The Brandenburg lane now carries its first reviewed lower-secondary functions corridor, the first tightly shared lower-secondary algebra/equation follow-on corridor across variables, term transformations, linear equations, and linear systems, its first reviewed upper-secondary E-phase analysis entry corridor, its first reviewed Q1 model-functions follow-on corridor, its first reviewed Q2 integral-calculus follow-on corridor, its first reviewed Q2 stochastics follow-on corridor, its first reviewed Q2 data-and-distribution follow-on corridor, and its first reviewed Q2 survey-and-critique follow-on corridor on the canonical spine. Active mapped surface reaches J7-J10, the shared E/F functions corridor, the shared E/F algebra/equation corridor, the Brandenburg E-phase derivative starter strip, the Q1 model-functions strip around exponential, logarithmic, and periodic functions, the Q2 integral strip around upper and lower sums, reconstructed stock, the Fundamental Theorem, antiderivatives, and first area and context applications, the Q2 stochastics strip around tree diagrams, contingency tables, conditional probabilities, stochastic independence, urn models, and simulations, the Q2 data-and-distribution strip around sample characteristics, random variables, discrete distributions, histograms, and first binomial situations, the Q2 survey-and-critique strip around statistical survey planning, data preparation, and critical evaluation with descriptive measures, and the structural upper-secondary phase bridge E/Q1-Q4.
states.nextStep: Keep widening the shared Brandenburg/Berlin lower-secondary lane beyond the now active functions and algebra/equation corridors, then choose whether the next reviewed move stays on that shared Sek-I spine or returns to another active upper-secondary follow-on lane.
